messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: P1 - regional inference serving errors affecting hosted API in us-east-1. Page created 1951234567. Escalation: oncall
Maya (oncall): seeing increased 5xx on /v1/generate, spike started ~23:04 UTC. I'm taking lead.
Samir (eng-sre): joining, pulled logs — nginx upstream returns 502 from runtime nodes, connection reset.
Samir (eng-sre): rolling back the last autoscaler change from this morning (scale-down policy tweak) as a hotfix. running: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime AUTOSCALE_POLICY=previous`
Maya (oncall): TY. I'm switching traffic to fallback model pool to reduce load. Adding routing override now.
Priya (product): quick ask — can we estimate customer impact surface? which routes and customers saw errors vs degraded latency?
Samir (eng-sre): running queries against request logs. rough numbers: ~12% of requests in us-east-1 between 23:04-23:16 hit 5xx, higher for longer sequences.
Lina (customer-success): flagging top 4 customers in that region (IDs: r-corp, fintechx, searchly, docuapi). prepping outreach.
Billing-Ops: tagging for SLA review. please add incident timeline + duration of degraded service once we have final window.
Maya (oncall): current mitigation: restored autoscaler config, drained two overloaded pods, traffic shifted to fallback pools. error rate down to ~1.2% and falling.
Samir (eng-sre): confirm: no data loss, just request failures/timeouts. KV cache was healthy.
Priya (product): OK — customer impact: partial failures for some requests, increased latency for others. We'll likely need to evaluate SLA credit eligibility for any customers who exceed our outage threshold.
Ethan (support): drafting customer-facing note. Will post a draft here for legal/ops review.
Ethan (support): DRAFT EMAIL:
```
Hello,

We wanted to let you know about a partial service degradation affecting Redwood's hosted inference in the us-east-1 region between 2026-03-14 23:04 UTC and 2026-03-14 23:16 UTC. During this window some requests received 5xx errors or experienced elevated latency. We mitigated the issue by reverting a recent autoscaler config change and shifting traffic to a fallback model pool. No customer data was lost.

If your usage experienced greater than N% error rate or you believe you were materially impacted, reply and we'll evaluate eligibility for SLA credits per our policy.

Apologies for the disruption — we take reliability seriously and are following up with a post-incident report.

Best,
Redwood Support
```
Maya (oncall): good. please make the timeframe granular once Samir confirms final window; also mention that we will perform a follow-up with root cause and corrective actions.
Lina (customer-success): tone is okay, suggest adding a bullet on mitigation steps and a short FAQ line about retries.
Priya (product): on SLA credit eligibility — remind: our policy grants credits when availability dips below 99.9% for a given billing period or for sustained failures above threshold in a rolling window. For partial regional degradation we evaluate per-customer usage during the incident window.
Billing-Ops: to start eligibility checks we need: customer list, percent of failed requests for that customer for the window, and total billable token count for that window.
Lina (customer-success): I'll pull customer usage and pass to Billing-Ops with priority.
Samir (eng-sre): attaching quick query we'll use to measure per-customer error rate:
```
select customer_id, count(*) as total, sum(case when status >= 500 then 1 else 0 end) as errors
from request_logs
where region='us-east-1' and ts >= '2026-03-14T23:04:00Z' and ts <= '2026-03-14T23:16:00Z'
group by customer_id
order by errors desc;
```
Ethan (support): also adding a status page update snippet — can someone approve?
```
Status: Partial degradation in us-east-1 (23:04 - 23:16 UTC)
Impact: Some API requests returned 5xx errors or experienced higher latency. Mitigation: Reverted autoscaler config and shifted traffic to fallback model pool. Current status: Resolved, monitoring.
```
Priya (product): approve. add link to post-incident report when available and note "no customer data loss".
Maya (oncall): final timeline I have: 23:04 detection -> 23:06 escalated -> 23:08 rollback applied -> 23:12 traffic shifted -> 23:16 error rate normalized. Use 23:04-23:16 as window.
Billing-Ops: received Lina's upload (r-corp, fintechx, searchly, docuapi). Starting calculations now. Expected turnaround ~2 hours.
Lina (customer-success): I'll queue personalized emails for the four customers; will propose credit amounts based on usage once Billing-Ops confirms eligibility.
Ethan (support): updated draft with timeline and mitigation and sent the support canned response to CS for those customers.
Maya (oncall): filing incident ticket for root-cause follow-up and postmortem, assigning to Samir + runtime team.
Samir (eng-sre): note for postmortem: autoscaler had a regression in connection backoff behaviour when concurrency surges coincide with long-sequence requests (affects runtime probe handling). Investigating fix and canary plan.
Billing-Ops: preliminary results: three customers exceed the internal threshold for SLA credits calculation. We'll prepare an itemized credit table and billing journal entry.
Lina (customer-success): looping in account execs with proposed outreach.
Priya (product): request to legal: please review the customer notification wording if any phrasing re: credits needs adjustments.
Maya (oncall): closing the page — monitoring continues. If anything pops back up, re-open thread.
Billing-Ops: final note: after we confirm credit amounts we'll run credits against next invoice cycle and send a reconciliation email.
Ethan (support): posting final customer note template here for records:
```
Hi <Customer>,

During the window 2026-03-14 23:04 - 23:16 UTC your traffic to Redwood hosted inference in us-east-1 experienced intermittent 5xx errors. We have credited your account $X per our SLA. The credit will appear on your next invoice.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```
Lina (customer-success): thanks team. i'll hold customer sends until Billing-Ops confirms amounts.
Priya (product): please attach the credit calculation artifacts to the incident postmortem.
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone — good mitigation and clear comms.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to resolved by Maya at 1951234599.
